job_clock_origin: REQUEST_ROI acceptance roi_request && roi_ready sets read_job_active=1, read_job_age=0; saturating increment while active, expiry at MAX_READ_JOB_CYCLES-1.
phase_clock_origin: phase_cycles resets in WAIT_OWNER and explicit state transitions; MAX_PHASE_CYCLES is a per-phase watchdog, not a global floor-to-result completion promise.
ESP_READ_clock_origin: First fully received and accepted typed OBS READ_FENCE sets readKnown_=true/readAt_=now. Repeated floor does not reset; RESULT requires elapsed<26000 and expiry fires elapsed>=26000.
FPGA_floor_delivery_gate: floor_published is set only after floor_inflight and frame_ready&&!frame_send&&!tb_valid&&tb_ready; RESULT also requires exact current read/floor/owner/phase.
rationale: 24s observed producer phase budget plus 2s bounded UART/scheduling margin. Floor can precede ROI acquisition/job start; this is an independent bounded receiver wait, not a proof every capture/compute fits or succeeds.
safe_failure: Busy producer, capture/ARM/owner/phase/job timeout, cancellation, lease loss or outer budget exhaustion can still fail and park; no blind motion or automatic retries are added.
wire_result: Existing normalized bar U0.16; trained PSI_Q8 conversion remains in FPGA, no reinterpretation at ESP.
